t: This bronze figure is the Gladstone Memorial, the national memorial to the statesman William Ewart Gladstone. Sculpted by Hamo Thornycroft between 1899 and 1905, it shows him in the robes of the Chancellor of the Exchequer. Around the plinth are allegorical figures of four Virtues: Courage, Brotherhood, Education and Aspiration. Gladstone was prime minister four times and an MP for over sixty years. Thornycroft was responsible for some of London's best-known statues, including Oliver Cromwell outside the Palace of Westminster. The memorial is Grade II listed.
